patch.value: Accept positional title argument in pm create

Agents naturally write 'pm create "the title" --type X' but the CLI required '--title'. Adding positional argument support removes a recurring friction point and matches the pattern used by update/close.

Added positional [title] argument to pm create. Title can be passed as positional shortcut or via --title flag. Updated help text and error guidance to mention the positional form. SDK contract description includes [required] marker so help payload still flags title as required for type-aware validation.
pm create "Title" --type Issue works without requiring --title flag
Implemented; positional title flows through register-mutation action, normalized via existing options pipeline, validated by requireStringOption with enhanced error guidance
